notes: Georgia: only 7 entries, because most pages could not be used. No official national register of clinics, duty rota or animal poison line was found (NFA, nfa.gov.ge, could not be opened: WebFetch provenance block; the only official contact seen, via Georgia Today, is the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture complaints hotline 1501, not a vet line). No duty_rota or poison_line entries. Only one own-site 24/7 claim (G-Vet Kutaisi, emergency help 24/7, and Vet House's contradictory 'round-the-clock' wording). Leads not yet verified from own pages (aggregator-only, names/addresses from eMia and Madloba): Tbilisi - Aibo (45 Sulkhan Tsintsadze St, Saburtalo); Batumi - GAF Batumi (49 Tbel Abuseridze St, emergency badge), Chuki (23 Kaczynski St and 16A Inasaridze St, emergency badge), Stark (107 Chavchavadze St), 4paws (22 Melikishvili St), Vet Help (8 Griboedov St), Ventura, IM-PULS, EuroVetServis, Kalandadze clinic; Kutaisi - NEOVET (Queen Tamar St, emergency badge), Geo-Vet (43 Chavchavadze Ave, emergency badge), Pet Med (45 Chavchavadze Ave), Kalandadze (21 Akaki Tsereteli St); Rustavi - Doctor Aibolit (34 M. Kostava Ave, emergency badge), Vet City; Telavi - Medoni (41D Agmashenebeli Ave); Zugdidi - VetHealth (15 Ioane Lazi St); Poti - 911-VET; Khashuri - GAF. Not found at all: Gori, Kazbegi/Stepantsminda, Borjomi, Mestia. Unreachable: nfa.gov.ge, zooplaza.ge, facebook pages (robots), yell.ge Agrarian University vet clinic page, batumiguide.ge (robots), vethouse.ge about/home (redirect loop http/https). Independent check 2026-11-11: all 8 entry source pages re-opened; names and phones confirmed for all 7 remaining entries, no phone fixes; G-Vet 24/7 claim confirmed on its own page (meta description only, no phone); Vet House, Vetlife, Bionika, Golden Vet, Zooplaza, Vetmedi stay emergency_24h false (own-page contradiction or aggregator-only); Balto removed (Madloba marks it Temporarily Closed, comments say it is not functioning and the building is for rent).
